findings.rationale: Real: my G1 fold left section 3 and P1.5 describing a merge. Folded: file map says subagent_statusline.rs writes only <sid>.tasks.json and never reads or merges <sid>.json; P1.5 acceptance validates the tasks row in that file and that <sid>.json is untouched.

Real: appending context-budget to the fallback produced a doubled path. Folded section 2.5: resolveLiveDir() returns a BASE (~/.autopilot on SSD fallback); each consumer appends its purpose segment, so the fallback state path is exactly the legacy ~/.autopilot/context-budget/<sid>.json, asserted by test.

Real: parser and tests contradicted each other. Folded section 2.5: lowercase then a grammar ^claude-([a-z]+)-[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)*(\[[a-z0-9]+\])?$ with group 1 as family; non-matching ids are unknown and never block; P3.3 tests now block CLAUDE-FABLE-5-1 and reject fable-ish and claude-fable.

Wording contradiction accepted and folded: section 6 skew text now states that an older codeforge leaves context-budget and foreman-guard on old behaviour while depth0-delegate-gate stays in warn and never blocks, with tests in both skew directions. The repair (make the gate a no-op without a live file) is refuted: the owner asked for a gate on depth-0 self-research in plain sessions where no live file may exist; section 2.6 already declares the nudge as new default-on behaviour, so the frozen compatibility contract is the declared one, not silence.
